title: get_all_pelanggan_should_return_customer_list
description: Test GET /api/v1/pelanggan to ensure it returns a 200 status code with an array of pelanggan data representing the customer list.

title: post_pelanggan_with_valid_data_should_create_customer
description: Test POST /api/v1/pelanggan with valid nama, telepon, alamat, and email fields to verify it returns 200 with the created pelanggan object.

title: post_pelanggan_with_invalid_data_should_return_validation_error
description: Test POST /api/v1/pelanggan with missing or invalid required fields to verify it returns a 400 validation error with appropriate messages.

title: get_all_layanan_should_return_service_list
description: Test GET /api/v1/layanan to ensure it returns a 200 status code with an array of layanan data representing available laundry services.

title: post_layanan_with_valid_data_should_create_service
description: Test POST /api/v1/layanan with valid nama_layanan, satuan, harga, and deskripsi to verify it returns 200 with the created layanan object.

title: post_layanan_with_invalid_data_should_return_validation_error
description: Test POST /api/v1/layanan with invalid harga or incomplete request body to verify it returns a 400 validation error prompting correction.

title: get_all_transaksi_should_return_transaction_list
description: Test GET /api/v1/transaksi to ensure it returns a 200 status code with an array of transaksi data showing transaction history and statuses.

title: post_transaksi_with_valid_data_should_create_transaction
description: Test POST /api/v1/transaksi with valid pelanggan_id, tanggal_masuk, tanggal_selesai, status, catatan, and layanan array to verify it returns 200 with the created transaksi object.

title: post_transaksi_with_invalid_data_should_return_validation_error
description: Test POST /api/v1/transaksi with invalid pelanggan_id or malformed layanan array to verify it returns a 400 validation error rejecting the transaction creation.
